# AI Release Check

> Browser-only pre-release checker for AI-made songs: checks title, artist, featured artists, lyrics, artwork and AI disclosure against the published rules of Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube, TuneCore Japan and DistroKid (23 rules, plus 3 optional JASRAC work-registration rules for AI-assisted songs, each with official source URL, section and date checked), tidies the metadata and writes a production record. Japanese UI. No network, no storage of inputs, MIT. Unofficial, not affiliated with any platform. Not legal advice.

- rules.json: rules(id, platform, field, level block/warn/info, status verified/unverified, check, rule, fix, source, section, checked)
- check.js: check(rules, song) -> per-platform verdict ok/warn/block with items; tidy(song, rules); productionRecord(song, report, date). Works in browser and node
- quota.js: free tier counter (3 songs/month, counted only on the device)
- sns.js: YouTube/X/TikTok post templates (ja/en) that state AI use
- index.html: single-file page (built by build_page.py from page/index.html)
- Limits: does not analyze audio; rules not confirmed in official docs are shown as "unverified", never as rejected; no numeric spam thresholds
